title: The Losers Might Be Next.
speaker: Figuring Out Money host

macro_themes.view: Growth vs value is extended; expects a mean-reversion rotation into beaten-down value, small caps, equal-weight and rate-sensitive names.
Yield closed 5.24%, a multi-year high; expects it to consolidate or pull back between now and after the midterms, which would fuel rotation.
Only ~26% of S&P stocks above 50-day MA and 42 sessions without a 1% down day; volatility often follows, but he stays long-focused.

calls.reason: Still a 'bull strong' environment near highs, but below declining 5-day MA; expected move 760.50-770 for next session.
calls.quote: We are still in a bull strong environment

calls.reason: Yield parabolic to decade highs; compares to 2018 midterm pattern and expects consolidation/pullback through the midterm seasonal period.
calls.quote: I think it's going to come off the back of a consolidating 10-year yield or some sort of a pullback

calls.reason: Equal weight ~7% off its high while cap-weight near highs; positive divergence suggests an equal-weight bounce/rotation.
calls.quote: perhaps we get into some sort of equal weight bounce as well as the market potentially pauses on the mega caps

notes: Host says 'It is September 28th' (Monday). Mentions casinos/gaming (DJUSCA), Nike, McDonald's as rate-sensitive bounce candidates without specific calls.
